# PcanWork

Canonical website: https://www.hexbyte.cn/
Current version: 0.6.2 (released 2026-09-10)
Product type: Windows 10/11 64-bit desktop CAN/CAN FD engineering analysis software.
Technology: Rust + Slint.

PcanWork supports PCAN (PEAK), ZLG, ZHCX and GCAN adapters. Real CAN/CAN FD acquisition and transmission require compatible hardware and the vendor driver. The current release does not provide a virtual CAN bus.

Core capabilities:
- CAN/CAN FD trace, filtering, grouping, statistics, curves, single/periodic transmission, CSV/ASC/BLF recording and replay.
- DBC decoding: Unsigned, Signed, IEEE Float and IEEE Double; Intel/Motorola byte order; factor, offset, unit and range.
- Project files and visual simulation panels with DBC-bound controls.
- printf-over-CAN embedded text logs, plus UDS and XCP entry points.
- Modbus TCP/RTU master and slave tools.
- Serial debugging and ANSI interactive terminal.

Version 0.6.2 changes and verification:
- Immediate-send ID and data increments continue from the previous result.
- Periodic task Stop reliably removes static and dynamic jobs; duplicate row delete was removed.
- High-resolution absolute-deadline scheduling improves 1 ms and 10 ms periodic timing.
- PcanWork, Serial Tool, Modbus Tools and the installer report version 0.6.2; installer size and SHA-256 were verified.
